title: kit.config.json
description: Configuration for the engineering-kit harness. scripts/verify.mjs runs gates[], scripts/doc-truth.mjs checks claims[]. Every relative path (apps[].path, gates[].cwd, gates[].requires, claims[].doc and the paths inside claims[].kind) is resolved against the directory that CONTAINS kit.config.json (the config root), so both scripts work from any subdirectory. A fresh config with empty apps/claims/gates arrays is valid: the scripts exit 0 with a visible warning instead of failing.

project.description: Project identity, filled in by `npx engineering-kit init`.

name.description: Human-readable project name (e.g. "ten-du-an"). Shown in the verify.mjs banner.

chatLanguage.description: Language AI agents chat with the user in (mirrors AGENTS.md).

apps.description: One entry per application in the repo. Informational for the harness scripts (gates[] is what actually runs); keeps a machine-readable map of the repo.

path.description: App root directory, relative to the config root.

srcPath.description: Primary source directory of the app, relative to the config root (a good target for lines:<path> claims).

verify.description: The app's main verify command, as documentation only. The commands actually run by scripts/verify.mjs are defined in gates[].

expectedTests.description: Expected number of tests, as documentation only; null = not measured. Numbers pinned against reality belong in claims[], which doc-truth.mjs enforces.

docPaths.description: Where the kit's process docs live, relative to the config root.

agentsConfig.description: Directory of agent process docs (issue tracker conventions, triage labels, ...).

skillPaths.description: Declarative single source for where skills live — see SKILL-SOURCES.md. NOT consumed by verify.mjs/doc-truth.mjs: register these paths in your tools (Claude Code scans .claude/skills natively; OpenCode needs opencode.json skills.paths; ZCode discovers project scope; Antigravity scans the workspace). Default [".claude/skills"] (repo-local, versioned, reproducible). Append a global/home path only as a personal-convenience layer — fresh clones and CI will not see it, and repo docs must never depend on it. Keep skill names unique across layers (shadowing precedence differs per tool).

claims.description: Docs-vs-truth checks for scripts/doc-truth.mjs. Each claim pins a number written in a doc to a measurable fact. Number convention: the DOT is the thousands separator, so "5.670" means 5670 (doc-truth strips dots before comparing). A claim whose regex no longer matches any line is a WARNING (claim drift), not a failure; a claim that matches but disagrees with reality is a FAIL (exit 1).

doc.description: Doc file to scan, relative to the config root.

re.description: Regex as a JSON string — escape backslashes ("\\d"). Compiled with the 'm' flag and tested line by line; the FIRST matching line wins and its capture group 1 is the docs number (for kind exists:<path> no capture group is needed). Anchor with ^...$ so edits elsewhere in the doc cannot hijack the match.

kind.description: What to measure. "lines:<path>": sum of NON-EMPTY lines of all files git lists under <path> (git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard = tracked + untracked-but-not-ignored, i.e. the files about to be committed); if <path> is a single file, its own count is used. Lines are split on /\r?\n/ (CRLF-safe) and a spaces-only line counts as NON-empty — never trim. "exists:<path>": the path must exist on disk.

gates.description: Verify gates run by scripts/verify.mjs: serial, fail-fast, in array order (put fast doc-truth gates first, slow tests last). An empty array is valid: verify exits 0 with a warning so a fresh install never fails.

id.description: Gate id, shown in --list and the PASS/FAIL lines; the target of --only/--skip.

cmd.description: Executable to spawn. On Windows, extension-less commands (npm, npx, python, node, git) and .cmd/.bat wrappers run through cmd.exe (it resolves PATHEXT); commands with a concrete extension (.exe, .py, ...) spawn directly so paths with spaces are never shell-mangled. Bare npm/npx therefore work cross-platform.

args.description: Arguments passed to cmd. Optional; defaults to [].

cwd.description: Working directory for the gate, relative to the config root. Optional; defaults to ".".

tags.description: Free-form labels. The tag "slow" marks gates that --fast skips (e.g. the long pytest suite).

requires.description: Preflight paths (venv, node_modules, build artifacts) that must exist before any gate runs; resolved relative to the config root. If any is missing, verify lists them all and exits 1 WITHOUT running any gate.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged into the child process env — on top of PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 and PYTHONUTF8=1, which verify always sets for every gate.

optional.description: true: a failure prints a WARN line and the run CONTINUES; an optional gate never changes the exit code. Default false (fail-fast).
